reason_for_correction: the v1 percentile cluster bootstrap can become discrete and anti-conservative with only four species clusters; v2 preserves the equal-individual estimand but uses few-cluster robust uncertainty

population_estimand.mean_interval_method_when_cluster_count_: intercept-only CR1 cluster-robust standard error with Student-t critical value on G-1 degrees of freedom
population_estimand.positive_fraction_lower_method: minimum of group-level Wilson score lower bound and cluster-aware CR1 Student-t lower bound on the binary positive-gain indicator

score_reconstruction.species: G_species from the frozen species-baseline decomposition
score_reconstruction.species_context: G_total = G_species + G_context from the frozen decomposition
score_reconstruction.purpose: feed the frozen per-individual gains through the same public information-transfer and population-summary path used by future real-data applications

supports: descriptive equal-individual mean and prevalence summaries with uncertainty that acknowledges only four represented species clusters
historical correction of the v1 few-cluster bootstrap inference without changing any frozen per-individual gain
does_not_support: replacement or reclassification of the frozen empirical_state_prediction_mixed primary endpoint
a claim that the species-cluster population mean total gain is robustly positive
random sampling of the four represented species from a defined species superpopulation
a causal effect of species identity or context
model refitting, retuning or raw-source-data reanalysis
